name: Sparse SH Order Increment
definition: A training strategy that starts with SH order 0 and selectively increases the SH order for specific Gaussians based on their view-dependent color error, reducing GPU memory consumption compared to using full 3rd-order SH for all Gaussians.
summary: Sparse SH Order Increment reduces memory by initializing all Gaussians at SH order zero and selectively promoting only those with high color error to higher orders.
